versions.changelog:
glyph-fidelity 0.1.1

- Added a changelog (CHANGELOG.md) and license file.
- Removed the sample skill-card documentation.
- Updated version metadata to 1.2.0 and added more detailed workflow and checks for glyph integrity.
- Clarified that this skill is focused on auditing for letterform fidelity, with explicit question guidelines and an expanded "missing glyphs" rule.
- Tightened alignment with the related text-typesetting skill for all-caps tracking logic.

- Initial release of glyph-fidelity: a skill for protecting letterform structure during case and tracking transforms.
- Adds continuous, font-size dependent tracking for all-caps text, refining over banded values.
- Detects and fixes ligature collision risks under negative tracking by disabling ligatures for affected ranges only.
- Identifies inline acronyms (3+ uppercase letters) in running text and applies subrange tracking and size adjustments to preserve paragraph color.
- Enforces use of true small caps from font OpenType features, never simulated by scaling capitals.
- Integrates with text-typesetting and microtypography skills, focusing on edge-case refinements.
